gloss: way of holding; how to hold; grip

definitions.gloss: way of holding; how to hold something; grip
definitions.explanation: The manner in which something is held or gripped. From the verb stem {持|も}ち (holding) plus the suffix 〜{方|かた} (way of doing).

examples.japanese: お{箸|はし}の{持|も}ち{方|かた}を{習|なら}う。
examples.english: To learn how to hold chopsticks.

examples.japanese: ペンの{持|も}ち{方|かた}が{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: My way of holding the pen is poor.

examples.japanese: ラケットの{持|も}ち{方|かた}を{変|か}えたら、ボールがよく{飛|と}ぶようになった。
examples.english: After I changed my grip on the racket, the ball started flying better.

notes:
Formed from the verb stem {持|も}ち plus 〜{方|かた} ('way of ~'), a productive pattern that attaches to almost any verb stem.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {箸|はし}の{持|も}ち{方|かた}: how to hold chopsticks
- {持|も}ち{方|かた}を{教|おし}える: to teach how to hold something

RELATED PATTERN:
〜{方|かた} forms 'how to' nouns from verbs: {作|つく}り{方|かた} (how to make), {使|つか}い{方|かた} (how to use), {書|か}き{方|かた} (how to write).
